ei.title: The Value of Play for Entrepreneurs

fullPassage: Easier said than done, but time away and time for play is invaluable to the busy entrepreneur. If you think that's frivolous, you need to change your mindset or face the consequences down the road. There's an epidemic of burnout in entrepreneur culture, and it stems from the always-on, always-plugged-in, always-working nature of work today. True, some of this is par for the course when you're starting a business. But whatever time you can pull away to let your mind rest and play will pay back in both productivity and creativity. Don't believe me? Even Albert Einstein espoused the benefits of play. When he was stuck on a certain problem, instead of powering through, he would take time away to play his violin. He attributed some of his biggest breakthroughs to this practice.

questions.passage: Easier said than done, but time away and time for play is (A)[worthless / invaluable] to the busy entrepreneur. If you think that's frivolous, you need to change your mindset or face the consequences down the road. There's an epidemic of burnout in entrepreneur culture, and it stems from the always-on, always-plugged-in, always-working nature of work today. True, some of this is par for the course when you're starting a business. But whatever time you can pull away to let your mind rest and play will pay back in both (B)[laziness / productivity] and (C)[boredom / creativity]. Don't believe me? Even Albert Einstein espoused the benefits of play. When he was stuck on a certain problem, instead of powering through, he would take time away to play his violin. He attributed some of his biggest breakthroughs to this practice.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 휴식과 놀이 시간은 '매우 귀중한(invaluable)', '생산성(productivity)'과 '창의성(creativity)'으로 보답.
det.analysis:
❌ ① worthless — productivity — creativity
❌ ② invaluable — laziness — creativity
✅ ③ invaluable — productivity — creativity
❌ ④ invaluable — productivity — boredom
(A) 글 전체가 놀이 시간의 가치를 역설하므로 invaluable(매우 귀중한).
(B) 정신을 쉬게 하면 '생산성'으로 보답.
(C) '창의성'으로도 보답.
det.tip: invaluable(매우 귀중한) ≠ in + valuable이 아님 — '가치를 매길 수 없을 만큼 소중한'

questions.passage: Easier said than done, but time away and time for play is invaluable to the busy entrepreneur. If you think that's frivolous, you need to change your mindset or face the consequences down the road. True, some of this is par for the course when you're starting a business. But whatever time you can pull away to let your mind rest and play will pay back in both productivity and creativity. Don't believe me? Even Albert Einstein (C)[rejected / espoused] the benefits of play. When he was stuck on a certain problem, instead of powering through, he would take time away to play his violin. He attributed some of his biggest breakthroughs to this practice.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 번아웃의 '유행병(epidemic)', 상시 근무에서 '비롯되다(stems from)', 아인슈타인도 놀이를 '옹호했다(espoused)'.
det.analysis:
✅ ① epidemic — stems from — espoused
❌ ② remedy — stems from — espoused
❌ ③ epidemic — leads to — espoused
❌ ④ epidemic — stems from — rejected
(A) 번아웃이 '유행병'처럼 번지고 있다.
(B) 상시 근무 특성에서 '비롯된다(stems from)'. leads to는 인과 역전.
(C) 아인슈타인도 놀이의 이점을 '옹호했다(espoused)'.
det.tip: epidemic(유행병) / stem from(~에서 비롯되다) / espouse(옹호하다)

det.korean: '하찮은(frivolous)' 것이라 생각하면 사고방식을 바꿔라. 문제에 '막혔을 때(stuck)' 바이올린을 연주함. 돌파구를 이 습관 '덕분으로(attributed)' 돌림.
det.analysis:
❌ ① essential — stuck — attributed

(B) 문제에 '막혔을(stuck)' 때 밀어붙이지 않고 쉼.
(C) 돌파구를 이 습관 '덕분으로 돌렸다(attributed)'.
det.tip: frivolous(하찮은) / stuck(막힌) / attribute A to B(A를 B의 덕분으로 돌리다)
